item.tib: srid rgyal nag mo'i mthu bsgrub kyi bskang ba'i mdos gzhung yid bzhin gter chen
item.coloph: de ltar sngon tshe'i gshen rnams kyis/ thugs kyi bcud phyung man ngag brgyad/ bskang bzlog (skong zlog) bsad pa gcig tu dril/ 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ 'phrin las gang bcol thog med 'grub/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i thog chen yin/ dam med rnams la gsang rgya tham/ dam ldan yongs la phan par shog ces pa ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ zhal lung ci bzhin ma nor bar/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bris pa dge sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
